name: Grant Pipeline
description: Lean grant opportunity qualification, application tracking, eligibility evidence and funding deadlines for biotech research teams under 50 FTE.
whenToUse: Use for a small for-profit biotech or research team assessing public or private research funding calls, recording applicant eligibility, tracking 3–20 applications and managing deadlines with verifiable funding outcomes.
whenNotToUse: Not for applicant portals, automatic grant applications, nonprofit fundraising CRM, institutional ERP/procurement, funder operations, legal grant contracts, or automated claim that a commercial biotech qualifies.

instructions: Read the newest read_app_template_guidance(resource:"authoring") and resource:"usage" fully (follow nextOffset), then read_app_design and this exact Grant Pipeline template by digest. Confirm the user wants applicant-side small biotech research funding, not grantmaker administration. Make one saved TrialAgents internal app using the standard approval flow and existing account/permissions; do not add sign-in, subscriptions, passwords, users, email services or hidden jobs. Keep the official TrialAgents linked watermark in the host, without drawing a fake logo or sidebar icon. Prepare/reuse authorized opportunities, criteria, applications, milestones tables with actual scalar field names and reviewed tableMap; do not use fictional demo records or pretend call IDs are real. Configure a real source and date verification before calling an opportunity Open. Require assessed mandatory criteria and a named reviewer before recording Eligible. Require submittedAt for Submitted, and confirmed amount/date/official award notice for Awarded. Aggregate only by recorded currency and never count awarded as paid cash. Keep the compact six-screen interface and native custom-layout declaration; adapt only on user request. Validate five screens plus report, CRUD review, drag layout integration, 320/390/768/1100/1440 responsive and denied mappings. Saved app and real records operate without automation. After app creation only if requested, inspect list_app_automations/read_app_automation and read_app_automation_guide, then use prepare_app_monitoring for a ChatGPT weekly official-call research or prepare_app_action for a TrialAgents email reminder, with stable authoringKey and separate review; never create a per-app ChatGPT task or send an email directly from frontend. Manual research remains valid. See AUTOMATION_RECIPES.md and HOST_INTEGRATION.md. Version 1.0.1 targets guidance 1.3.9. The catalog source never declares templateConfiguration/templateBindings; AppTemplates.operation injects these once. Create parent records first, use saved receipt UUIDs in child references, and never seed fictional examples. Keep input drafts after proposals; only the trusted receipt means saved. Reconcile an ambiguous response rather than submitting a duplicate create. Return all linked Eligible applications to Pending before changing opportunity/criterion evidence. Record links are immutable on edit. All required sources must be complete before writes. Do not relabel currency on an amount-bearing opportunity or one with linked applications.

quickStart: Create a private TrialAgents app named Grant Pipeline for a small biotech funding team. Do not add app-specific accounts, authentication, billing or organization management.
Reuse or create authorized scalar TrialAgents tables for grant opportunities, eligibility checks, applications and milestones, preserving real record IDs and app-wide permission enforcement.
Map actual table IDs and lowercase column keys in tableMap; grant access only to existing permitted tables/fields and keep archived as a scalar boolean.
Review one funder call with official HTTPS source, identification, exact deadline, deadline version, verification date, applicant restrictions and explicit currency.
Enter mandatory eligibility checks and assign human review; add an application and 1–5 key writing tasks. Save only after user confirmation.
Preview all six screens and the native layout gear, test missing fields and mobile width, then confirm the saved app. Optional ChatGPT/emails are configured separately only after approval.

documentation.dataContract: Four independent authorized scalar record types: opportunities(title, funder, callId, focus, region, applicantType, deadline ISO date, deadlineVersion, verifiedAt, sourceUrl HTTPS, amountMax, currency, owner, status, notes, archived); criteria(opportunityId foreign key, name, mandatory boolean, status Unknown/Yes/No, evidenceUrl, reason, reviewer, assessedAt, archived); applications(opportunityId, project, lead, stage, requestedAmount, currency, eligibilityDecision Pending/Eligible/Ineligible, submittedAt, awardedAmount, awardDate, awardNoticeUrl, nextStep, reviewer, notes, archived); milestones(applicationId, title, owner, due, status, completedAt, evidence, archived). IDs are platform record IDs, never display names. Every catalog binding is a reviewed logical-to-physical field mapping in tableMap and an authorized templateBindings declaration. No grants data ships as real records: demo_data.json is entirely fictional and used only in standalone preview. Never assume a for-profit biotech is eligible. Stage amounts are never receipts; do not sum currencies. Funding outcomes require recorded official evidence. All reads bounded to two 100-row pages per role, and incomplete access invalidates any authoritative aggregate. All fields use multiple:false. Optional empty dates and numbers are null, not empty strings. URLs/narratives/references use text; relationship text holds actual saved UUIDs, not arrays or labels. Physical keys are snake_case. For each role configure tableMap as a JSON string: {role:{typeId:actual UUID,fields:{logicalKey:physical_key},writableFields:[authorized logical keys]}}. Bind physical fields with a current schemaVersion, supported kind and permitted manifest mode. Complete schemas follow in quickStart; no external repo file is required. Reads capped at 200 per role: unknown totals, denied/short pages, missing mappings and arrays are incomplete, never zero. Search and pagination cover the loaded window only; narrow authorized scope for larger datasets. Dependency/provenance guards are app checks, not database foreign-key or cross-app integrity constraints. In Funding review, submitted or decided requests need an amount and currency; if either is missing the funding totals are withheld. Recorded awards require a positive amount, nonfuture notification date and official evidence; awards are never receipts. Future dates are allowed for deadlines/due dates, not verification, assessment, submission, award notification or completion.
documentation.interactionContract: Six single-title screens: Funding pulse (deadlines and stage signals), Opportunities (search, filters, paging, official source, edit/duplicate/archive), Eligibility (mandatory checklist, evidence, reviewer, human eligibility decision), Applications (lean Kanban and reviewed status changes), Deadlines (eight-week view, assigned tasks with completion evidence), Funding review (per-currency submitted/awarded totals, dated facts and optional research prompt). Row 3-dot menus support Edit, Duplicate, Archive (soft delete). Archive is blocked when live linked records exist. Forms validate mandatory fields and prepare records.propose; nothing is saved until the trusted host confirmation. The settings gear uses native tracker:layout, custom templateLayoutSchema and versioned customLayout profile to reorder screens and visible columns; no extra in-app settings tab. Keyboard focus and explicit Close/Cancel, responsive 320–1440 widths, and one primary page scroll. No native networking, calendar sync, portal submission or active assistant inside rendered JS. Native field layout controls table columns and draft form order/visibility; Additional fields exposes hidden/required values. Criteria action menus include duplicate/archive. Application board and criteria register have paging. Deadline timeline covers the current register page. Incomplete sources suppress totals and eligibility, and disallow edits. Preserved drafts are not committed records.
documentation.lifecycle: Discover and read this exact catalog ID/version/digest; preview with the user then save via reviewed app creation. Revisions use new immutable versions and retain existing app identity, database bindings, archived history, authorization and real source records. Source controls only prepare records.propose, with expectedVersion on edits and no blind overwrite. Host confirmation owns commit/receipt. Duplicate creates a distinct draft record and clears unsafe award/call evidence. Failure retains unsaved draft and the last published app. Layout-only changes must pass host validation and preserve stable schema IDs. Research/email task definitions are independent and must not block app open or writes. The standalone preview uses fictional in-memory data and a local confirmation dialog only. Pin the exact version and digest. Use one requestKey for initial app preparation/save and reconcile its receipt on ambiguity. Revisions target the same saved component ID with expectedVersion; never create a replacement to recover. Ignore cancels only the pending review, and Close/Cancel discards the local form. Reopen saved output to verify. App archive suspends attached work; restore/copy does not activate it. The asOf option is a deadline comparison reference date, not a reconstructed historical snapshot.
limitations: No direct grant application submissions, funder portal credentials, funder data API, disbursement accounting, grant payments or applicant login system.

Automatic grant discovery or deadline monitoring is NOT implemented in frontend-js. ChatGPT can research official calls only in an authorized chat/approved automation; missing evidence remains unverified.
Only four compact tables; no consortium CRM, institutional ERP, multi-level legal signoff or grantmaker administration. Recommended scope: 1–3 grant owners and 5–30 opportunities per active cycle.

Custom HTML sections inherit app-level TrialAgents access. Sensitive grant/private proposal documents need an appropriately protected separate app or supported standard sections; hiding a screen is not an access boundary.
Stage counts and currency-specific amounts are calculated only from complete authorized reads, which are bounded at 200 records per role. Missing bindings or overflow are visibly flagged.

Real host operation, native settings persistence and optional task delivery require an end-to-end post-install test. The standalone preview simulates reviewed proposals but never writes to TrialAgents.

examples.prompt: Set up a grant tracker for our 18-person biotech working on biomarker assay development and CMC scale-up.
examples.expectedBehavior: Create one private app with four compact linked tables, selected grant sources, eligible entity restrictions, named owners, stages and a five-action deadline list; request approval before saving.

examples.prompt: Check whether our EU registered biotech can apply to these two official funding calls.
examples.expectedBehavior: Read source URLs and explicit criteria, record Unknown until verified, allow only an authorized human-reviewed eligibility decision; never assume commercial SMEs are eligible.

examples.prompt: Show the upcoming 30-day grant deadlines and all submitted or awarded values for management.
examples.expectedBehavior: Display date verified entries, list blocker tasks, report submitted and officially awarded amounts separately per currency, distinguish awards from cash and flag incomplete authorization.

examples.prompt: Research biotech funding opportunities every week and notify us when a good match has been verified.
examples.expectedBehavior: After app save and separate user approval, prepare a source-backed ChatGPT monitoring recipe via TrialAgents Automations. No jobs are created inside the app and no applicant messages are sent automatically.

tasks.whenUseful: A small biotech searching regularly for new calls may use a weekly ChatGPT research monitor; one-off projects can simply request manual discovery. Internal deadline email alerts are optional and separate.
tasks.readRequirements: Authorized work themes, applicant legal entity type and locations, known funding calls, recorded official URLs, call IDs, checked-at date, grant history and allowed proposal destinations. Deduplicate by official funder/call ID/version. Do not read private HR, patient or clinical subject data. Check read_automation_setup at app creation/first use/reconnect. Use the current guide and actual host-supported subscription; do not fabricate runner activation. Define owner-approved expiry, source/write scopes and run limits. Without ongoing write authority keep results in private monitoring history for manual review. Read only one authorized scope and checkpoint verified complete coverage; expired/revoked grants stop writes. Use stable authoringKey grant_official_call_discovery_v1 for the monitor, grant_verified_call_email_v1 for the optional email. Reuse existing IDs and expected versions when updating; do not duplicate definitions on retries. Check setup without making app serving depend on it. No automation: manually add an official call, assess criteria, record an application and milestones, then prepare/confirm each change.
tasks.outputContract: Propose new official grants and date/source evidence as unverified opportunity drafts, with human eligibility review; list changed deadlines and next action. No automatic eligibility grant, portal submission, notification to applicants or funders, or accounting claims. For optional email use fixed subject "Grant pipeline update available" and fixed body "Open https://platform.trialagents.com to review your authorized grant pipeline." Do not invent interpolation placeholders. Registered owner and explicitly selected app-authorized team only; no external/address-column recipients. Respect platform throttling, cancellation and state rechecks. No email digest modes or subdaily email schedules. Never repeat successful research because delivery failed. Disabled definitions remain disabled on edit; outcomes belong in Logs. Suggested email trigger: the opportunities status field transitions into Open, with verified_at and source_url not empty and archived not true. Set recordTypeId to the actual opportunities table, use mapped physical fields for trigger/conditions/scope, inherit existing app access, and review the single-step action separately. Do not also send a completion email for this handoff. Email and research have independent authorization and expiry. Archive suspends definitions; restore/copy never enables them.
tasks.promptExample: For the saved Grant Pipeline app, once weekly examine official EU/UK/US sources for OPEN competitive R&D grants explicitly allowing a commercial biotech in our jurisdiction, focused on translational/preclinical/CMC/platform technologies. Record call ID, funder, primary official URL, deadline, date verified, funding instrument and entity requirements. Deduplicate saved call IDs and create ONLY reviewed opportunity drafts. Keep uncertain matches and changed dates flagged for an authorized owner. Never apply or email funders. Deduplicate using official funder, call ID and notice version plus source URL. Do not advance coverage on partial or unavailable sources. Return no_update only with complete coverage and an approved quiet policy. Never mark Eligible, Submitted or Awarded. Use one reviewed weekly calendar monitor in the owner timezone (default manual/no automation), initial lookback 7 days and coalesced catch-up; store expiry and bounded write limits in the reviewed platform configuration. No per-app ChatGPT task. Suggested owner-approved weekly slot: Monday 09:00 in their confirmed IANA timezone, anchored to the first agreed local date, with authorization expiry explicitly recorded. Use inheritAppAccess:true and only current approved app-bound fields/write scopes; no grant is created implicitly.
